data.title: Class captain vote count hits a KeyError
story: The class captain election app counts votes in a dictionary (dict). As soon as the first vote arrives, a KeyError appears.
Read the error: which key is not in the dictionary yet?

explanation: result[name] fails with a KeyError when that name has not been counted yet. result.get(name, 0) returns 0 for a missing key, so the count can be increased right away.
hints: Read the last line of the error: a KeyError names the key that was not found.
When the first vote for "Ani" arrives, is "Ani" already in the result dictionary?
Try result.get(name, 0): it gives 0 when the key is not there yet.
